snippet.title: The Purple Peacock - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
The Purple Peacock is a 2D point-and-click adventure that blends noir storytelling with intricate puzzles and hidden secrets. As a classic 2D point-and-click adventure, The Purple Peacock features inventory-based puzzle solving, interactive dialogue, environmental exploration, and carefully placed clues. It emphasizes story-driven investigation, character interaction, and a richly detailed world that rewards observation and curiosity.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4163140/The_Purple_Peacock/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
